subject: Discovery follow-up: Acme - Private/VPC & SOC 2 questions
messages:
From: John Thompson <john.thompson@acme.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lee <sara.lee@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today - security posture and next steps

Hey Marcus,

Thanks for the product demo this morning — it was helpful to see how Redwood handles batching and failover. Per our conversation, the security team has a few follow-ups before we can move forward with a proof-of-concept: 

- SOC 2: can you confirm current SOC 2 status and whether theres a report we can review (redacted is fine)?
- Data residency & GDPR: we need confirmation on EU data residency options and whether you support data processing agreements (DPA).
- HIPAA: we have a couple healthcare customers in scope; is HIPAA BA covered or available?
- Vendor security questionnaire (SSQ): attaching our initial SSQ (light) — would appreciate if you kick off a QA response and point to any gaps.
- Private/VPC/on-prem: we’d like a short note on network isolation options (VPC peering, private link, air-gapped on-prem) and any sample deployment diagram we can share with our infra team.

Can you send a short recap and next steps? If helpful, we can schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra/security folks next week.

Thanks,
John

Attachment: acme_ssq_initial.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: John Thompson <john.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today - security posture and next steps

John — thanks for the note and for sharing the SSQ. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap (from our call):
- You’re evaluating Redwood for customer-facing inference workloads with strict controls on data residency and auditability.
- Primary asks: SOC 2 evidence, GDPR/DPA confirmation, HIPAA support, and vendor SSQ completion.
- Deployment model: preference for VPC/private deployment for production; POC can run on hosted with network controls.

Answers & attachments (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant. I’m attaching a redacted SOC 2 report we can share under an NDA if needed. (redwood_soc2_redacted.pdf)
- GDPR/DPA: We support DPAs and have data residency options in US and EU regions; we can provision a dedicated regional endpoint for EU data.
- HIPAA: We offer HIPAA-ready configurations for Private deployments (customer-controlled keys, audit logs). We’ll need to sign a BAA and validate the data flows during onboarding.
- SSQ: Thanks for the SSQ. Monica will lead the SSQ response (assigning to @monica_patel). We aim to return a first-pass SSQ within 3 business days.
- Private/VPC/on-prem: See attached high-level deployment diagram (redwood_private_deploy_diagram_v1.png). Options:
  * Hosted (shared tenancy) with customer-specified regional processing — fastest POC.
  * Dedicated (reserved GPU pool in our cloud) in a customer VPC via private link — network isolation + SLA.
  * Private (customer-managed VPC or on-prem package) — supports air-gapped installs for regulated workloads.

Proposed next steps:
1) Monica to complete SSQ answers and return a tracked document (3 business days).
2) Marcus/Monica to share redacted SOC 2 report and BAA template.
3) Schedule a 60-min security/infra deep-dive with your security and network folks — suggested times Wed/Thu next week.
4) If you’d like, we can provision a POC tenant in the EU region for data residency testing.

Let me know preferred time for the deep-dive and whether you want the SOC 2 under NDA.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_soc2_redacted.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: redwood_private_deploy_diagram_v1.png (PNG)

From: John Thompson <john.thompson@acme.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lee <sara.lee@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today - security posture and next steps

Marcus/Monica — thanks for the fast reply and the attachments. A few replies inline: 

- SOC 2: redacted report looks good. We’ll loop in procurement for the NDA if needed.
- GDPR/DPA: EU endpoint for POC sounds good; we’ll confirm which datasets need to remain in-region.
- HIPAA: we’ll need the BAA and a short list of controls for Private deployment.
- SSQ: we’ve filled out a couple more rows — sending updated file (see attached). Can Monica please flag any items she needs clarification on?
- Deployment diagram: our infra lead asked whether the private package supports air-gapped installs (no outbound internet). Is that something Redwood supports? If yes, what limitations should we expect (model updates, monitoring)?

We’re good to schedule the deep-dive next Thursday at 11:00am PT if that works for your team.

Thanks,
John

Attachment: acme_ssq_initial_filled.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: John Thompson <john.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today - security posture and next steps

John — great, Thursday 11:00am PT works for us. Quick responses to the air-gapped question and next steps: 

Air-gapped / on-prem notes:
- Yes, Redwood supports air-gapped on-prem installations for our Private package. Typical constraints:
  * Model updates and some telemetry require an offline update process (we ship model artifacts and a signed update bundle you can apply).
  * Monitoring and metric collection can be run locally; we provide an on-prem telemetry agent and an offline log aggregation recipe.
  * No outbound control-plane connectivity: customers manage a control-plane bridge for secure, periodic syncs if desired.
  * Secret management: HSM/KMS integrations available; customers can opt to keep keys in their HSM.

What we’ll deliver before the call:
- Monica will send the completed SSQ (tracked) and flag clarifying items (ETA: EOD tomorrow).
- I will share our BAA template and a short control mapping for HIPAA (ETA: EOD tomorrow).
- We can provision an EU POC tenant; let us know which datasets to target and we’ll enable regional processing.

Calendar invite sent for Thu 2027-08-12 11:00am PT with zoom + tech leads. Monica will lead the SSQ thread from here.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
